PART OF: Spark UI Guide series (linked from failing-spark-jobs)
NOTE: Very sparse page — three options only, no images.

=== MAIN CONTENT ===
"If you're losing spot instances, you may be using an instance type that has a high reclaim rate."

Three options:
1. Change instance types — use AWS Spot Instance Advisor to evaluate reclaim frequency rates
2. Stop using spot instances
3. Review Databricks spot instance optimization guidance

=== EXTERNAL LINKS ===
- https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/spot/instance-advisor/ (AWS Spot Instance Advisor)
